Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the birth date as "6 October 1819" instead of the correct "10 June 1819" as reported consistently by both Britannica and Wikipedia. This error likely occurred due to a misreading or misinterpretation of the data, as the sources clearly stated "10 June 1819," yet the Planner reversed the day and month. This mistake was directly responsible for providing the wrong final solution to the real-world problem.
